title: Mercy in one shorter sitting
subtitle: A shorter sitting for when mercy is already close
description: A short return for the hour when kindness still feels undeserved. It teaches the heart to receive mercy before trying to earn it.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Mercy gives Naam and even reunites what has wandered.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Return is possible because grace precedes your recovery.
